definitions.explanation: Having strong, clear colors that are very bright and noticeable.
Done with impressive skill and precision.

examples.japanese: {鮮|あざ}やかな{色|いろ}の{花|はな}が{咲|さ}いている。
{鮮|あざ}やかな{手際|てぎわ}で{料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: She prepared the meal with brilliant skill.

examples.japanese: {紅葉|こうよう}が{鮮|あざ}やかだ。

notes:
{鮮|あざ}やか is a na-adjective meaning vivid, brilliant, or impressive.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {鮮|あざ}やかな{色|いろ} (vivid color)
- Adverb: {鮮|あざ}やかに (vividly, brilliantly)
- Noun: {鮮|あざ}やかさ (vividness, brilliance)

SENSE 1 - VIVID COLORS:
- {鮮|あざ}やかな{緑|みどり}: vivid green
- {鮮|あざ}やかな{紅葉|こうよう}: brilliant autumn leaves
- {色|いろ}が{鮮|あざ}やかだ: the colors are vivid

SENSE 2 - SKILLFUL/IMPRESSIVE:
- {鮮|あざ}やかな{手際|てぎわ}: brilliant skill/technique
- {鮮|あざ}やかに{解決|かいけつ}する: to solve brilliantly
- {鮮|あざ}やかな{勝利|しょうり}: impressive victory

OTHER USES:
- {鮮|あざ}やかな{記憶|きおく}: vivid memory
- {鮮|あざ}やかに{蘇|よみがえ}る: to come back vividly
